त्वच्(आ̆)
(1) a) CINNAMOMUM ZEYLANICUM NEES (Avk); many sources identify
त्वच् with C. ZEYLANICUM BREYN, the name used by Hooker,
see vol. 5, p. 131-132; C. ZEYLANICUM BREYN includes both
C. ZEYLANICUM NEES and C. ZEYLANICUM BLUME, which are
distinguished as separate species in the Index Kewensis; =
LAURUS CINNAMOMUM LINN. (Roxb., p. 336-337) = L. CASSIA
LINN. (Ainslie 1, p. 58-59; Roxb., p. 337); Roxb. distinguishes
L. CINNAMOMUM from L. CASSIA, but these names are synonyms
acc. to the Index Kewensis;
b) C. ZEYLANICUM BREYN (Dutt; Gul; HK; KB 3, p. 2149-2150);
